notes: Read all ten target units and all twelve candidates; there is no preceding context. Exclude dedication, quoted poem fragments and platform/process self-praise as non-policy material. Restore the six actual Republican civic-value characterizations with the United States/American referents supplied by the preamble, without treating poetic fragments as factual policy evidence.

claims.claim_text: The Republican Party identifies courage against foreign adversaries as an ideal uniting Americans.
The Republican Party identifies optimistic patriotism motivated by freedom as an ideal uniting Americans.
The Republican Party identifies devotion to every person's inherent dignity and rights as an ideal uniting Americans.
The Republican Party identifies self-reliance, civic commitment and concern for others as ideals uniting Americans.
The Republican Party describes distrust of government interference in Americans' lives as a unifying U.S. ideal.
The Republican Party identifies dedication to a rule of law protecting and preserving liberty as an ideal uniting Americans.
